dogecoin.text: Then, in early 2023, I decided to sell my Dogecoin. It was a tough decision, but I felt like it was the right time for me. Though I sold, the memories and lessons from my Dogecoin journey will stay with me forever.

It was fun, but also scary because the price kept changing a lot.Even with the ups and downs, I stuck with Dogecoin and made some friends along the way. It became more than just a coin to me—it was a journey and a community I'll always remember.

@BillyM2k @Laika_Layer2
